newsitem.title: ISRAEL: RESEARCH ALERT - Orbotech is strong buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Orbotech is strong buy.

text.p: Salomon Brothers said it had retained its strong-buy recommendation for Israel's Orbotech Ltd, saying the company would be using its $30 million cash holding to make acquisitions.

Analyst Victor Halpert noted that the company, a maker of printed circuit board inspection systems, would be earning net capital gains of $15.5 million from the sale of its interest of Opal Ltd, announced in November.

"There may be some concern that this sale will reduce income from affiliated companies by around $1.6-1.7 million a year, replacing it with roughly $12 million in financial income," Halpert said. "Nonetheless, we believe that Orbotech will use these proceeds for acquisitions relatively quickly."
He also cited the recovery of the flat panel display market, for which Orbotech also makes products. He estimated sales for the company's shadow mask product to be $10-20 million annually from 1998.
